text: Dongfeng Motor Corporation Ltd. is a Chinese central state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Wuhan, Hubei, controlled and managed by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC).
short: Dongfeng Motor Corporation is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise under SASAC.
